## 升级前请阅读 / Before upgrading

- 从数据库谱系不兼容的旧版本跨代升级前，请备份或导出重要数据；应用沿用既有的数据集重建规则，不转换历史数据，Agent 数据清理保留非 Agent 配置。使用已退役 Computer 契约的会话需新建会话，原历史保留，个人 Agent 请重新选择 Computer 动作。
- Back up or export important data before upgrading from an incompatible older database lineage. Existing dataset rebuild rules remain in effect without converting historical data; Agent clean cuts preserve non-Agent configuration. Retired Computer bindings require a new session and reselected actions for personal Agents; existing history is retained.

## 更新内容 / Highlights

- 语音输入以系统快捷键和字幕工具栏为入口，无需连接外置键盘；快捷键可自定义，并以平台键帽显示。
- 重新整理语音键盘设置；外置四键板默认关闭，由用户主动开启。K1 控制 NomiFun 主窗口，串口占用会显示具体错误，不影响软件语音输入。
- 应用升级维护与语音、设备就绪解耦；macOS 旧键盘服务状态不再阻断启动、退出和更新。
- 保留 ASR 握手失败的具体原因与可操作诊断，改善开发运行期隔离和重启可靠性。

- Use system shortcuts and the subtitle toolbar for voice input without an external keyboard; customize bindings and preview them as platform keycaps.
- Reorganize voice keyboard settings and add a disabled-by-default external keyboard adapter. K1 controls the main window; occupied serial ports produce specific diagnostics without blocking software voice input.
- Separate application maintenance from voice/device readiness and isolate macOS legacy keyboard state from startup, shutdown and updates.
- Preserve actionable ASR handshake failures and improve development runtime isolation and restart reliability.

## macOS 首发 / Initial macOS release

- [Intel 安装包 / installer](https://github.com/nomifun/nomifun-desktop/releases/download/v0.8.21/NomiFun_0.8.21_x64.dmg)
- 系统要求 / Requires macOS 14.0 or later. 两种架构均提供 Developer ID 签名、公证和签名 updater，发布至 GitHub 与 CrabNebula Cloud。Both architectures include Developer ID signing, notarization and signed updater archives, published to GitHub and CrabNebula Cloud.
- 本次首发仅提供 macOS Apple Silicon 和 Intel，未构建 Windows、Linux 或 AppImage。This initial publication includes Apple Silicon and Intel macOS artifacts; Windows, Linux and AppImage are not built in this release.
